name: webAI Frontline
summary: On-device AI that answers plain-language questions across your own approved technical documentation, with the cited source page for every answer and no internet connection. Launched August 26, 2026; webAI says it ran a regional jet fleet's roughly 34,000-page manual set on one iPad and cut documentation search during an engine change by at least 66% at a European regional maintenance operation.

Launched August 26, 2026; webAI says it ran a regional jet fleet's roughly 34,000-page manual set on one iPad and cut documentation search during an engine change by at least 66% at a European regional maintenance operation.
whyItMatters: Works where connectivity is poor or cloud AI is not allowed, and the cited page keeps the tech in the approved data. It is sold through co-development engagements; recommended hardware is an iPad Pro (M4 or M5, 12 GB RAM or more).
